risks: Business authority trigger and professional-review prerequisite remain open.
No current driver, migration runner, authentication tooling or durable event publisher exists.
A durable Matter cannot depend on disappearing fixture state; snapshot admission is mandatory.
Cross-service identity and Matter transactions cannot share a database transaction.
At-least-once event publication needs an outbox or event publication must be deferred.
Tenant scoping omissions can expose customer relationship/private context.
